result.rationale: Verifiable in the diff: refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw `fetch` Response object when credential sync mode is active (`return response;` after `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT...)`). The Google caller does `const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token;` — a fetch Response has no `.data` property, and the Hubspot caller types the return as `HubspotToken` and reads SDK fields directly. Neither caller parses the response body in sync mode, so token refresh would fail when the sync endpoint is configured. This is a real mechanism introduced by th
